messages:
jen: Hey folks — rough timing: my flight back Sunday got moved up and I need to swap coverage. I’m on Sat 22:00-06:00 (overnight) and was hoping someone could cover the 02:00-06:00 slice on Sunday morning instead — I can take a different evening next week as trade. @kai @omar any chance?

kai: I can do Sat night but only until ~02:00 PST. travel day for me on Sun so not good after that. happy to take 22:00-02:00 though.

omar: I can pick up 02:00-06:00 on Sun. that works with my schedule.

lina: I can also cover Sun morning if needed, but i prefer to keep it as backup. also can take a weekday evening swap if jen needs.

matt: quick ask — jen, can you drop a short handoff note with any ongoing risks and the current canaries? saves time during the swap.

jen: yes — adding handoff in thread. main things: prod msg queue has a small backlog on async-embedder (~4k items) being drained by dedupe job, no active rollouts, last deploy was 2026-02-28 canary -> stable, no flaky tests recently. contact on-call infra escalation: @kai for kernel/GPU issues, @omar for routing/caching.

jen: handoff snippet (copyable):
```
Handoff: Sat 22:00->Sun 06:00 (splitting 22:00-02:00 @kai, 02:00-06:00 @omar)
Current risks: async-embedder backlog ~4k, watch dedupe job logs at /logs/async-embedder
Recent deploy: 2026-02-28 canary->stable
Escalation: infra -> @kai, routing/cache -> @omar
Runbooks: https://confluence.redwood.infra/oncall/runbooks
Notes: no data-sensitive requests expected; metrics dashboards normal
```

oncall-bot: Rotation change requested: provisional swap scheduled in rotation queue. Please confirm by replying with "confirm swap". If no confirmation within 2 hours, request expires.

kai: confirm swap — I'll cover 22:00-02:00. :thumbsup:

omar: confirm swap — I'll cover 02:00-06:00.

lina: noted, will be backup for 02:00-06:00 if anything comes up.

matt: thanks all. jen — update pager duty note with the snippet and add contact numbers?

jen: done. added phone numbers and the dedupe job run command in the confluence snippet. really appreciate it, team. :pray:
